defs.def: a large wild animal of the dog family, that lives and hunts in groups 狼verb

ex.s: I remember her reading a magazine while taking the part of the Wolf in a game of “Little Red Riding Hood” with my brother’s two daughters.
ex.t: 我记得她一边读杂志，一边和我哥哥的两个女儿玩“小红帽”游戏，扮演大灰狼。

ex.s: And unplanned human activities have proved the idea of top﹣down control by top predators to be true． In the ocean， we fished for top predators such as cod on an industrial scale， while on land， we killed off large predators such as wolves． These actions have greatly affected the ecological balance．
ex.t: 而人类无计划的活动已经证明了顶级捕食者自上而下控制的观点是正确的。在海洋中，我们以工业规模捕捞鳕鱼等顶级捕食者，而在陆地上，我们消灭了狼等大型捕食者。这些行为极大地影响了生态平衡。

ex.s: After years of heated debate, gray wolves were reintroduced to Yellowstone National Park.
ex.t: 经过多年的激烈争论后，灰狼被重新引入黄石国家公园。

ex.s: Fourteen wolves were caught in Canada and transported to the park.
ex.t: 在加拿大捕获了14只狼并被运送到公园。

ex.s: By last year, the Yellowstone wolf population had grown to more than 170 wolves.
ex.t: 到去年为止，黄石地区的灰狼数量已增长到170多只。

ex.s: Gray wolves once were seen here and there in the Yellowstone area and much of the continental United States, but they were gradually displaced by human development.
ex.t: 灰狼曾经出现在黄石地区和美国大陆许多地方，但由于人类活动的影响，它们逐渐被驱逐。

ex.s: By the 1920s, wolves had practically disappeared from the Yellowstone area.
ex.t: 到20世纪20年代，灰狼实际上已从黄石地区消失。

ex.s: The disappearance of the wolves had many unexpected results.
ex.t: 灰狼的消失带来了许多意想不到的结果。

ex.s: In the absence of wolves, coyote populations also grew quickly.
ex.t: 在没有狼的情况下，郊狼的数量也迅速增长。

ex.s: As early as 1966, biologists asked the government to consider reintroducing wolves to Yellowstone Park.
ex.t: 早在1966年，生物学家就请求政府考虑将狼重新引入黄石公园。

ex.s: They hoped that wolves would be able to control the elk and coyote problems.
ex.t: 他们希望狼能够控制麋鹿和土狼的问题。

ex.s: Many farmers opposed the plan because they feared that wolves would kill their farm animals or pets.
ex.t: 许多农民反对这项计划，因为他们担心狼会杀死他们的农场动物或宠物。

ex.s: The US Fish and Wildlife Service carefully monitors and manages the wolf packs in Yellowstone.
ex.t: 美国鱼类和野生动物局对黄石公园的狼群进行了仔细的监测和管理。

ex.s: Today, the debate continues over how well the gray wolf is fitting in at Yellowstone.
ex.t: 今天，关于灰狼在黄石的适应情况如何，争论仍在继续。

ex.s: The Yellowstone wolf project has been a valuable experiment to help biologists decide whether to reintroduce wolves to other parts of the country as well.
ex.t: 黄石狼项目是一项有价值的实验，有助于生物学家决定是否将狼重新引入该国其他地区。

ex.s: The conflict between farmers and gray wolves.
ex.t: 农民与灰狼之间的冲突。

ex.s: The reintroduction of wolves to Yellowstone Park.
ex.t: 将狼重新引入黄石公园。

ex.s: What did the disappearance of gray wolves bring about？
ex.t: 灰狼的消失带来了什么后果？

ex.s: What is the author’s attitude towards the Yellowstone wolf project？
ex.t: 作者对黄石狼项目持什么态度？

ex.s: But when he looked to the side, he saw instantly that it wasn’t a dog at all, but a wolf, quickly catching up with him.
ex.t: 但当他看着侧面时，他立刻看到它根本不是一只狗，而是一只狼，很快赶上了他。

ex.s: With one hand on the bars, he fired the spray at the wolf.
ex.t: 一只手扶着车把，他对着狼喷出了喷雾。

ex.s: He knew that zxxk once he hit the hill, he’d be easy caught up and the wolf’s teeth would be tearing into his flesh.
ex.t: 他知道一旦上了坡，他就很容易被追上，狼的牙齿将会撕咬进他的肉里。

ex.s: As they got closer, they realized that the dog was a wolf.
ex.t: 当他们靠近时，才意识到那“狗”其实是一只狼。

ex.s: He pulled in front of it as the wolf was catching up fast, just a dozen yards away now.
ex.t: 他冲到那辆车前面，这时狼正在快速逼近，只有十几码远了。

ex.s: Only the mountain has lived long enough to listen objectively to the howl of a wolf.
ex.t: 只有大山活得足够久，才能客观地聆听狼的嚎叫。

ex.s: Those unable to decipher the hidden meaning know nevertheless that it is there, for it is felt in all wolf country, and distinguishes that country from all other land.
ex.t: 那些无法解读其中隐藏含义的人仍然知道它就在那里，因为这在所有狼的领地中都能感受到，并将那片土地与其他所有土地区别开来。

ex.s: Even without sight or sound of wolf, it is implicit in a hundred small events: the midnight whinny of a pack horse, the rattle of rolling rocks, the bound of a fleeing deer, the way shadows lie under the spruces.
ex.t: 即使没有狼的目光或声音，它也隐含在一百个小事件中：一匹包马的午夜呜咽，滚滚的岩石的响响，一头逃跑的鹿的束缚，阴影埋伏在树丛下的方式。

ex.s: My own conviction on this score dates from the day I saw a wolf die.
ex.t: 我本人对这点的信念，始于我亲眼看见一只狼死去的那天。

ex.s: When she climbed the bank toward us and shook out her tail, we realized our error: it was a wolf.
ex.t: 当她爬上河岸朝我们走来并抖了抖尾巴时，我们才意识到我们的错误：那是一头狼。
